claims.text: Backup repository re-configuration task creates individual folders for each backup agent pointed to the CIFS repository
Managed computers must be members of an AD domain for individual subfolders
Each managed agent writing to the share creates a separate subfolder
Machine account has access to its own subfolder but not others
If checkbox not selected, all backups stored in the shared folder

A.notes: Omits same-domain, Everyone R/W and non-inheritance prerequisites; the 7-day claim cites a cloud-repository screenshot caption that does not state a default.

claims.text: Select the create individual sub-folders checkbox; each agent creates its own subfolder with machine account as owner, no access to others
Managed computers are AD domain members
Shared folder in same AD domain
Everyone has Read and Write permissions on the share
Default retention 7 days, earliest restore points then removed
Click Refresh to request a new code from Microsoft
Veeam Explorer for Exchange device code valid 15 minutes and can be refreshed
VB365 device code valid for 15 minutes
For Modern authentication the device code is copied and used to sign in to Microsoft Identity platform

B.notes: The refresh claim cites [2], a Basic-auth CAS server step that says nothing about device codes.
